overall_assessment: All 28 courses were reviewed in full as presented in the packet: both year flags are genuine, whereas the short HOVVEIL120 page is faithfully captured and refers readers to the general study plan, so its short flag is not an extraction defect. Across the suspects and 25 controls, the only uncaptured page text is breadcrumbs; there is no demonstrated loss of on-page plan content, generic fallback, substantial duplication or structural collapse, and packet truncation markers are not extraction failures. The remaining institution-wide defect is minor page boilerplate in otherwise readable text; current pipeline code already suppresses later-year course_plan values, but the audited extracted_text still associates those pages with earlier offerings.

findings.evidence: Sist hentet fra FS (Felles studentsystem) 17. okt. 2026 07:09:49
findings.description: The extraction retains the site navigation label Innholdsfortegnelse in all 28 courses and the FS synchronization timestamp in all 24 texts whose endings are visible; the other four endings are capped by the packet. These are page-interface/system details rather than course-plan content. This minor contamination also appears throughout the random controls despite the junk pre-pass count being zero. Course facts, named contacts, evaluation text and literature pointers remain legitimate plan content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The hiof selector in R/institution_config.R includes #vrtx-fs-emne-content or .entry-content, and the hiof configuration supplies neither exclude nor post_fn to remove the contents-navigation label and FS synchronization line before page_fulltext() returns the text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a hiof-specific post_fn that removes only complete lines matching ^[ \t]*Innholdsfortegnelse[ \t]*$ and ^[ \t]*Sist hentet fra FS \(Felles studentsystem\)[^\r\n]*$, then trims excess blank lines. Preserve plan revision dates, facts and contacts. Rebuild the extracted-text artifact from the existing harvest.
